overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole reviewed a presentation on the Wellington Transformation Study and approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy.

items.title: Presentation on the Wellington Transformation Study (Paper 26095)
items.summary: Kept the paper in committee after receiving a presentation from planning consultants regarding future land use, design, and economic development strategies for the Wellington neighborhood.

items.title: Executive Session for Litigation Strategy (Paper 26053)
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy for Turtog v. City of Medford et al.
